topic: why Live Nation earns more profit from ticketing than from concerts on a fraction of the revenue
storyAngle: Concerts bring in most of the revenue; ticketing, a small slice of it, brings in twice the profit.
doNotClaim: Adjusted operating income (AOI) is Live Nation's own measure of segment profit, not net income.
Do not state any ticket fee amount or fee percentage.
Do not mention lawsuits, regulators or any specific event.

facts.claim: Live Nation 2024 total revenue was about $23.16 billion.
say: twenty three point two billion dollars

facts.claim: Live Nation 2024 CONCERTS segment revenue was about $19.0 billion and its adjusted operating income (AOI) was $529.7 million.
Live Nation 2024 TICKETING segment revenue was about $2.99 billion and its adjusted operating income (AOI) was $1,123.6 million.

derived.claim: Ticketing was about 13% of total revenue (2.99 / 23.16).
Ticketing AOI was about twice Concerts AOI (1,123.6 / 529.7 = 2.1).
